ModMetadata.Name: Better Ore Detector
ModMetadata.Author: aproposmath
ModMetadata.Description:
- Better visuals: black unlit lights, dimmed ore image - Vein compass for the ore detector (optional, enabled by default)
[b]Installation[/b] This is a [b]StationeersLaunchPad[/b] Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx to be installed. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
Source Code: https://github.com/aproposmath/StationeersBetterOreDetector
ModMetadata.ChangeLog:
v0.3.0:
- Configuration option to disable the compass feature - More accurate compass - Fix issue with red unlit lits on startup - Dim the ore image when the helmet light is on
